<<<FINDINGS>>>
- [BLOCKER] R1: `Enum.TryParse(targetType, s, true, out object e)` on line 307 breaks compilation under .NET Framework 4.8 (`net48`). Non-generic `Enum.TryParse(Type, string, bool, out object)` was introduced in .NET Core 2.0 / .NET Standard 2.1 and does not exist in `net48`. Compiling against NinjaTrader 8's target framework fails with `CS1501: No overload for method 'TryParse' takes 4 arguments`.
- [MAJOR] R1: `foreach (JProperty jp in jObj.Properties())` on line 387 dereferences `jObj` without a null check. In the flat legacy loop (line 474: `_relationships.Add(ParseRelationship(kv.Value, kv.Key));`), any null dictionary value (e.g. `{"Account_Leader": null}`) passes `jObj = null` into `Populate`, throwing `NullReferenceException`. Because `LoadFromDisk` cleared `_relationships` and `_groups` at lines 438-439, this exception is caught by the outer catch block (line 480) and silently leaves the engine holding zero configuration, disarming all trade copying.
<<<END FINDINGS>>>
<<<REQUIRED>>>
- In `TryConvertToken` (line 307), replace `if (Enum.TryParse(targetType, s, true, out object e) && Enum.IsDefined(targetType, e))` with a `net48`-compatible parsing construct:
```csharp
try
{
    object e = Enum.Parse(targetType, s, true);
    if (Enum.IsDefined(targetType, e))
    {
        value = e;
        return true;
    }
}
catch
{
}
```
- In `Populate` (line 383), add an immediate null check before iterating properties:
```csharp
if (jObj == null)
    return present;
```
